rows.grounds: compound: netra-mantrita-sad-vastra-baddha-netrān (acc. pl. m., eyes bound by cloth consecrated with netra-mantra) + acañcalān (acc. pl. m., motionless); MVT ch8 initiation rite context (blindfolding).
sandhi-split: ananyahṛdayībhūtān (acc. pl. m., become of undivided heart) + balāt (ind., firmly/by force) + ittham (ind., thus); describes prepared initiands.
2nd pl. imperative of ni-rudh (to restrain/confine); ritual instruction in samaya initiation sequence.
